summary: Stellantis Finance US Inc., a wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Stellantis N.V., priced $2.5 billion of senior unsecured notes under an existing shelf: $1.25 billion of 6.750% notes due 2031 at 99.950 and $1.25 billion of 7.400% notes due 2036 at 99.909. Both series are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Stellantis N.V., rank pari passu with other unsubordinated unsecured debt, settle September 16, 2026, pay semiannually March 16 and September 16, and carry optional make-whole and tax redemptions plus a change-of-control put. Joint bookrunners include Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, Intesa Sanpaolo, Morgan Stanley, Natixis, RBC, and SMBC Nikko. This is a routine investment-grade-style debt takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing spreads, subscription demand, and any rating actions.
